rule: AUTHORSHIP RULE (Sion, WhatsApp 17:00 BST 24 Oct 2026: "If the mp actually said something then have his profile post it. If the newspaper published something have them post it. Other profiles should share or tag if it concerns them."). A post's author is the party that actually published, said or sent the item: an email by its sender (From header of the archived mail, data/email_senders.json), an article by its newspaper, a speech by the MP, a judgment by the court, a journal article by the journal, a platform notice by the platform. Other profiles are only @mentioned (tags) or share. Items with no identifiable publisher go out from the archive profile. tools/publishers.py applies this on every build and fails the build if an institution authors an item whose source is not theirs.
